findings.note: AB 1116 (Berman, Elections: voter registration) lets a person register online without a California driver license or state ID if they give the last four digits of their Social Security number; the Secretary of State may verify identity from those digits, full name and date of birth; operative 2029. Vote record is from CalMatters Digital Democracy; the official leginfo site blocked automated access.
subjects: identity proof to register to vote online
